messages.content: Give me the price of a Tesla model S in India.

function.name: get_exchange_rate
function.description: Retrieve the current exchange rate between two currencies. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
**Tesla Model S – India**

| Item | Details |
|------|---------|
| **Official launch** | Tesla has not yet launched the Model S (or any Model 3/Model Y) in India, so there is no official price or availability. |
| **Estimated cost (if imported)** | Importing a Model S from the U.S. would involve:  |
| | • Base price (US$90 k–$100 k) |
| | • Import duty (≈ 35 % of the vehicle’s value) |
| | • GST (18 % on the duty‑plus‑value) |
| | • Additional taxes, registration, insurance, etc. |
| | Roughly, this would push the price to **₹1.4–1.6 crore** (≈ $190 k–$210 k). |
| **Why no official price?** | • Tesla has not announced a launch date or pricing strategy for India. |
| | • Import duties and taxes in India are high, making the vehicle expensive. |
| | • Tesla’s current focus is on markets where it can sell directly (U.S., EU, China, etc.). |

**Bottom line:** As of now, there is no official price for a Tesla Model S in India. If you were to import one, you could expect a cost in the range of ₹1.4–1.6 crore, but this is purely an estimate and not a retail price.
